title: Is this something you'd use?
author: Super_Golf_1404
selftext:
Hey, I just added a feature that pulls colors and style straight from reference images, part of a tool I'm building for creating seamless PBR materials. View the materials (and download them) by clicking the links below:

* [bricks](https://www.pbrgen.com/m/442258e9-0a20-40a4-9555-7db133939bd3)
* [hexagon tiles](https://www.pbrgen.com/m/da3ad6a3-ee9b-41d2-86b1-285f18f9eacc)
* [stone wall](https://www.pbrgen.com/m/20101b55-355e-4e75-83a8-58e45f4e48ec)
* [roof](https://www.pbrgen.com/m/3e506bc6-b2fc-43da-b414-154207261918)
* [pattern](https://www.pbrgen.com/m/0cc74fea-61ba-492e-b0f4-0a825a39beaf)
* [wood floor](https://www.pbrgen.com/m/c5ebf1f4-cc3d-487b-9199-c5d9e5a0017f)

Feedback welcome!
